question: Is compute/aircloud (aieev.com, AIEEV) the same company as Aircloud at aircloud.dev, or two companies that share a name?
why: computeprices.com lists Aircloud with the site aircloud.dev, a reserved-cluster and on-demand GPU provider, while compute/aircloud is AirCloud of aieev.com, a Korean hourly RTX 4090 provider. The two were drafted as separate records (compute/aircloud-dev); an entity override in registry/entities.tsv may be needed so a search for the name returns both.
